comments.text: What an eye-opening documentary! 🇨🇳👏 China is full of fascinating contrasts, from futuristic megacities to the everyday struggles of ordinary workers. A monthly salary of 5,700 yuan raises an interesting question: how comfortably can people actually live in such an expensive and rapidly developing country? The beautiful scenery and real-life stories make this video truly worth watching! 🌍❤
